## STRIPE - Register Project

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/stripe-register-project

**Description:** Enregistre les secrets Stripe d'un projet via API backend.
Appele par le plugin au demarrage.

**Input:**
```json
{
  "project_id": "torah-fun",
  "stripe_key": "sk_live_xxx",
  "webhook_secret": "whsec_xxx",
  "display_name": "Torah App",
  "tenant_id": "815368074995040286",
  "backend_api_url": "https://apistaging.azy.solutions",
  "backend_service_token": "service_xxx"
}

API Call: POST /api/admin/stripe/projects

Response:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Project registered",
  "project": { "project_id": "torah-fun", "environment": "staging" }
}
